name: snap_to_unreal
summary: Real-time motion capture from a Snap Camera Kit lens (phone webcam → BodyTrack landmarks) → MocapFrame (Meta Body joint vocabulary) → verify_alignment → UE5 Live Link. Mobile-friendly alternative to Meta XR; the same MocapFrame contract feeds the same animation_registry, so character rigs animate identically whether the capture came from Quest or phone.

inputs.name: snap_lens_id
inputs.notes: Snap Studio lens ID that posts pose frames to the local relay

passes.notes: Snap Studio lens posts pose+face frames to local relay at http://127.0.0.1:7787/snap_mocap. Relay writes JSONL rows to ~/.cc/snap_lens_mocap.jsonl. Connector reads from the sink path env-overridable via SNAP_MOCAP_SINK.

Snap's 17-joint BodyTrack vocabulary → Meta Body 24-joint via SNAP_BODYTRACK_TO_META_BODY remap. Missing joints emitted as identity transforms so UE5 skeleton stays aligned. Output at ~/.cc/snap_lens_mocap.normalized.jsonl.
Add source row to studio/assets/_animation_sources/snap_lens_<id>.json with watch=true verified_at=null. mark_source_verified after frame_count threshold.
Per-frame topology + rig-fit + anchor-proximity. Snap's sparse 17-joint sometimes fails the 50% threshold; threshold tunable per source via the registry.
UDP JSON datagrams at fps; UE5 Live Link subject auto-appears. Dry-run unless MSPC_UNREAL_LIVE=1.

depends_on: Snap Studio Lens authored under SnapKit account (TEXT-PLACEHOLDER on Snap side)
